caption: Enforcement Point
name: enforcement_point
description: Where a decision was made and enforced. The distinguishing property of in-process authorization is that this is a business method inside the application, not a gateway or a proxy in front of it.

type.caption: Type
type.description: in_process_method | gateway | proxy | database | external_pdp | other

name.caption: Name
name.description: Fully-qualified operation identifier, e.g. the namespace, type and method.

runtime.caption: Runtime
runtime.description: Host or runtime, e.g. aspnet_core, servicestack, grpc, functions, worker, queue_consumer, orleans, dapr.

stage_id.description: Which of the three decision points enforced this decision. Request means no data access occurred at all.

stage.description: The vendor-specific stage label, alongside stage_id.
